sources.entry: Bitwarden Menu - Bitwarden Password Manager in your menu bar

summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app that wraps the Bitwarden Browser Extension so it can be used from the menu bar, unofficial and no longer receiving extension updates.
summary.what_it_does: Bitwarden Menu is a simple macOS application that places the Bitwarden Browser Extension in the menu bar. The README says the app bundles a slightly modified copy of the extension, copied into the app during the build by a Bitwarden/build.sh script. It is not affiliated with Bitwarden or 8bit Solutions. The author states the app stopped receiving extension updates at version 1.49.0, when the extension moved to the Safari Web Extension API, and it currently ships extension v1.48.1. Pre-built Bitwarden Menu.app files are offered on the Releases page. Building from source requires cloning with git submodules and opening the project in Xcode.
use_cases: Access Bitwarden vault from the macOS menu bar
Run the Bitwarden browser extension as a standalone Mac app
Build a custom macOS Bitwarden wrapper from source
Download an unsigned Bitwarden client for macOS
how_to_run: Ensure the submodule in Bitwarden/browser is initialized and updated
Run Bitwarden/build.sh to copy the modified extension into the app
Alternatively, download Bitwarden Menu.app from the Releases page
notable: Embeds a modified copy of the Bitwarden Browser Extension in a macOS menu bar app
Pinned to an old extension version (v1.48.1) because later versions use the Safari Web Extension API
Build pulls the extension in as a git submodule via build.sh
Distributed unsigned because the author has no Apple Developer Program enrollment
caveats: No longer receives updates to the Bitwarden extension; the author says it will likely stay on v1.48.1 and to use at your own risk
Not signed by an Apple Developer account, so macOS will treat the download as unsigned
Not associated with Bitwarden Inc. or 8bit Solutions LLC
